creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From the owner's note, 2026-11-10: "CMD k Omni bar for finding pane".

⌘K opens a search bar over every pane in every tab and window: its callsign, its name, its agent, its directory, and what it is doing. Picking a result focuses that pane, as a chord to a row does.

A match on a callsign (kettle, ivory, leopard) ranks above every other kind of match, so typing a callsign always lands on that pane first.

Open: whether the bar also runs actions (a command palette), or only finds panes. The owner confirmed finding panes.
title: A ⌘K bar that finds a pane by its callsign, name or what it is doing
